text: The warm sun fell on their backs, and they heard nothing and thought of nothing, for they had forgotten the rest of the world. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the ground shook with a deep roar that seemed to come from under the earth, and the cannon began to thunder again. <break time="0.8s" /> Far to the left rose the dark shape of Mont Valérien, from whose top white puffs of smoke burst out, one after another. <break time="0.8s" /> There they go again, said Sauvage with a shrug, while Morissot, who was watching his float, felt the anger of a peaceful man against these madmen. <break time="0.8s" /> They must be stupid to kill each other like that, he grumbled, and Sauvage replied, They are worse than animals. <break time="0.8s" /> While the two friends agreed that people would never be free, the cannon kept roaring, destroying homes and leaving wounds in mothers hearts that would never heal. <break time="0.8s" /> Such is life, said Sauvage, and Morissot answered with a little laugh, Say rather, such is death. <break time="0.8s" /> At that moment they felt someone behind them, and turning around, they saw four tall, bearded soldiers pointing rifles at them. <break time="0.8s" /> Their rods dropped from their hands and floated away, and within seconds the two friends were tied up, put into a boat, and taken to the island.
